description: This file defines the Parser class and related structures for parsing tokens into an abstract syntax tree (AST) in a code parsing or compilation context. It includes method declarations for parsing expressions, statements, and blocks, as well as utility functions for traversing and assigning comments in the parse tree.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing a sequence of tokens into an abstract syntax tree (AST). It provides static methods for parsing entire token streams, expressions, and values, as well as private methods for internal parsing logic.

classes.name: ParserHelper
classes.description: A helper structure associating prefix and infix parsing functions with their precedence for expression parsing.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Static method to parse a sequence of tokens into a ParseNode AST. Returns null on error.

methods.name: ParseExpression
methods.description: Static method to parse tokens as an expression.

methods.name: ParseValue
methods.description: Static method to parse tokens as a literal value.

methods.name: ParseExpression (private)
methods.description: Parses an expression with optional precedence.

methods.name: ParseList
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated list of tokens, allowing optional trailing commas.

methods.name: ParseFile
methods.description: Parses a complete file into a ParseNode.

methods.name: ParseBlock
methods.description: Parses a block of code enclosed in braces.

methods.name: TraverseOrder
methods.description: Generates pre- and post-order traversal of the parse tree.

methods.name: IsAssignment
methods.description: Checks if a node is an assignment.

methods.name: IsStatementBreak
methods.description: Checks if a token type indicates a statement break.

methods.name: Match
methods.description: Checks and consumes a token if it matches the expected type.

methods.name: Consume
methods.description: Consumes a token of a specific type, or any token if no type specified.
